Samir (AM): Heads-up — Cygnus (large fintech) just asked for a bespoke volume discount. They're pushing for 48% off list for a 3‑year reserved capacity + EU data residency. POC planned next month. Can we support?
Nate (DealDesk): Need ACV, committed GPU hours, and margin impact. 48% feels way above our normal floor.
Maria (Pricing): 48% is outside standard. For 3yr reserved w/ dedicated infra our usual max is ~35% unless strategic >$2.5M ARR or special concessions.
Jordan (SE): Technical note — they require private deployment (VPC) + HSM/KMS + SOC2 evidence. SE says onboarding ~8–12 weeks. That impacts go‑live timing.
Elaine (CorpSec): Their security questionnaire flagged SAML + data residency + pen test frequency. We can do private deploy but legal + infra addenda required. I'll need to prefill certs and whitepapers.
Samir (AM): They're pushing hard — product team says they'll sign if we hit 40% + 6 months free onboarding + 1yr guarantee to start. Pilot-to-prod within 6 months is a must for them.
Nate (DealDesk): Proposing counter-offer: 34% off for 2yr reserved commit + $60k onboarding credit, with a ramp clause: if they meet throughput targets at renewal, discount can go to 40%. Need Finance sign-off.
Maria (Pricing): I can greenlight 34% if min commit is $1.2M/year and we add SLA uplift addendum. Without that, the max I can take to is 30%.
FinanceBot: margin_calc_v2.pdf attached (internal): preliminary calc shows 34% discount -> projected gross margin ~28% at current cost assumptions.
Jordan (SE): Quick infra sketch for pricing:
```
Commit options:
- 2yr @ $1.2M/yr -> 34% discount
- 3yr @ $1.8M/yr -> 38% discount (requires exec signoff)
Onboarding: 8 weeks for private deploy, +4 weeks for HSM integration
```
Samir (AM): I'll present 34%/2yr + $60k onboarding credit + private deploy addendum on the next Exec call. If they counter at 40% I will escalate.
Nate (DealDesk): OK. @Finance and @Legal please review the numbers & addendum. @Elaine please start the questionnaire pack.
Elaine (CorpSec): On it — I'll send the prefilled security bundle and list of required docs by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (SE): I'll scope infra and deliver an 8‑week rollout plan and cost delta for HSM by tomorrow.
Samir (AM): Thanks team. Looping in Cygnus CISO on the next thread. Will update after Thurs call. :thumbsup:
